name: gold-loan-backend
description: Gold Loan & Pawn Shop Ledger Management Backend with WhatsApp/SMS Reminders

scripts.migrate: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const db = require('./src/config/db'); db.query(fs.readFileSync('./src/db/schema.sql', 'utf8')).then(() => console.log('Database migrated successfully')).catch(console.error).finally(() => process.exit());"
scripts.seed: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const db = require('./src/config/db'); db.query(fs.readFileSync('./src/db/seed.sql', 'utf8')).then(() => console.log('Database seeded successfully')).catch(console.error).finally(() => process.exit());"
